item.title: Download Magisk v31.0 APK (October 2026)
item.description: Magisk is the most popular open-source rooting solution for Android. Unlike older rooting methods that alter the system partition, Magisk provides root access using a "systemless" approach, allowing you to modify the system and install modules without actually touching or breaking the core OS files.
